summary: This survey reports institution-level enrollment and instructional activity for either July 1, 2004–June 30, 2005 or September 1, 2004–August 31, 2005, with each institution choosing one period. It covers IPEDS-eligible postsecondary institutions and reports activity separately for undergraduate and graduate levels where applicable. Before 2007, these 12-month measures were collected on the Fall enrollment survey form.

These tables report fall enrollment and related entering-class information from participating IPEDS postsecondary institutions, with the institution as the unit of observation and multiple records where enrollment is broken into student characteristics. Institutions on traditional academic-year calendars report enrollment as of October 15 or their official fall reporting date; institutions with differing or continuous calendars report students enrolled at any time from August 1 through October 31. The tables cover institutions reporting fall enrollment, with some measures restricted to institutions with undergraduate students or to particular calendar types, as noted in the table summaries.

Finance reports institution-level financial information for postsecondary institutions participating in Title IV, covering fiscal years ending between July 1, 2004 and June 30, 2005. Institutions report revenues, expenditures, assets, liabilities, and related amounts under the accounting standards applicable to them; public GASB institutions may also report separately identifiable component units. The survey is collected annually for institutions in the Finance reporting universe.

Graduation Rates reports student outcomes as of August 31, 2005 for full-time, first-time, degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate cohorts at eligible four-year, two-year, and less-than-two-year institutions. The unit is the institution’s entering cohort and its graduation-status category, with demographic breakdowns where collected; outcomes are tracked through 150% of normal completion time and include completion and transfer status. The cohort year varies by institution level, so the relevant table depends on whether the institution is four-year, two-year, or less-than-two-year.

Human Resources covers fall staff on the institutional payroll, generally counted as of November 1, and academic-year salary and fringe-benefit reporting for 2005-06. The unit of observation is an institution, with multiple records per institution for occupational, employment-status, rank, contract, benefit, or demographic categories. Coverage is limited to institutions and staff populations applicable to each HR collection, with some tables restricted by degree-granting status or institutional size. Race/ethnicity and gender reporting is optional in even-numbered years; because 2005 is odd, those demographic tables have data-collection availability under that rule.

Institutional Characteristics is a fall collection covering the 2005-06 academic year. It describes institutions in the 2005 IPEDS universe, with active institutions that participate in Title IV federal aid programs required to report; the unit of observation is generally the institution. The survey combines institution directory and classification information with offerings, admissions, services, mission, and student-charge data, although some fields apply only to institutions with the relevant programs or admissions policies.
